messages:
Maya: Quick thread to lock DP readiness gates and the invite checklist for the private beta. Need crisp pass/fail rules so eng and CS know when to expand.
Ethan: Agree. Propose three buckets: blocker (no-go), high (urgent), low (nice-to-have). Blocker examples: PII leakage, >10% harmful hallucinations on safety eval, or persistent auth failures.
Priya: Recruitment target: 10 partners live within 3 weeks; 15 in the bench. Diversity targets: at least 3 mid-market, 3 SMB, 2 regulated (finance/health). Compensation: $750 credits or equivalent integration hours.
Leo: Ops note: we must have a per-partner integration checklist before kickoff: network allowlist, sample data handling spec, prompt corpus (5-12 examples), and an SLO acceptability signoff.
Maya: Launch readiness metrics I suggest: partner activation >= 80% within 2 weeks, median latency within 1.5x baseline, weekly defect incidence <=2 per partner, and no unresolved blockers >48h.
Ethan: Add objective quality gate: automated eval suite (core intents) must not regress >3% on weighted F1 for 3 consecutive runs. If it does, freeze new onboarding until root cause fixed.
Priya: Outreach plan: personalized invites by Tue, follow-up 3 days later, commit-by date 10 days out. I'll capture opt-in form: company, use case, monthly tokens, security reqs, ideal kickoff window.
Leo: For rollback/runbook: if error rate spike >15% and affects >25% of requests for 4 hours, trigger model failover to previous stable tag and notify eng-oncall. We'll store the command as: `redwood route set --model previous --force` in the runbook.
ops-bot: Candidate added: medpay-inc accepted invite (token email sent)
Maya: Feedback cadence: short weekly check-ins + an async tracker sheet. Add a mid-beta deep-dive (30m) at week 2 for heavy integrators. We'll record Looms for all demos.
Ethan: Triage: every incoming issue needs reproducible steps + expected vs actual + severity tag. SEs should add the canonical prompt from the partner when file a ticket.
Priya: Legal asks: NDA template required pre-invite. Also add data processing addendum for partners sending sample data. I'll ping Legal for standard wording.
Leo: Instrumentation: per-partner dashboards with request volume, latency P95, error rate, and a list of open issues. Prefer Grafana shard per cohort.
Maya: Owners: Maya=PM, Priya=recruitment & legal coord, Ethan=quality gates & rollback, Leo=integration/runbooks & dashboards. Owners to post final playbook snippets by Fri COB.
Priya: I'll kick outreach tomorrow morning and share the sign-up sheet here.
Ethan: I'll draft the eval job + alert rules and push to infra repo.
Maya: If no objections by EOD we'll freeze this plan and start outreach. Thanks! :sparkles:
